verdict.rationale: The Gmail REST API is explicitly versioned. The send endpoint is POST https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/..., and the reference docs sit under /rest/v1/, so the versioning half of the story is evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, support windows, or migration guarantees. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, a version lifecycle/sunset timeline, a changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration of API stability.
